Name: Shear-jashub
Summary: Shear-jashub, whose name means 'a remnant shall return,' was Isaiah's son who stood with his father when Isaiah met Ahaz at the conduit of the upper pool.
KeyStory: Isaiah met Ahaz at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, with his son Shear-jashub beside him, and told the king not to fear Rezin and Pekah.
LifeLesson: God sometimes puts the promise in a child's name before the child can understand it.
